title: Cadmium Bis(phenyldithiocarbamate) as a Nanocrystal Shell-Growth Precursor

sections: Title, six authors, affiliations, DOI, abstract and graphical abstract; introduction distinguishes earlier CdSe belt structure/ligation results from this study.

Figure 1 and Scheme 1; complete materials/general procedures, analytical instruments, precursor synthesis/analysis and crystallization/X-ray acquisition opening. Printed amount anomalies visually confirmed.

X-ray acquisition/refinement continuation and full Table 1; DMSO-d6 NMR conversion and THF powder control; complete monolayer shell-growth/aliquot workup; precursor characterization and coordination-polymer interpretation.
Figure 2, all twelve Table 2 geometric entries, Figure 3 panels/caption; room-temperature excess-precursor observations and back exchange, continued next page.

Back-exchange continuation; 70 °C excess-precursor growth, Figure 4 three TEM panels/scales; thick-shell elemental/XRD interpretation; isolated-powder decomposition, NMR and species/timing descriptions.
Figures 5–7 and all captions, equations 1–3; normalized NMR integrations and proposed base-catalysis; controlled monolayer growth, PL and powder diffraction/preferred orientation.
Figure 8 and Figure 9 panels/scales; bundling versus nodule interpretation, c-axis compression, HRTEM continuity and mean/total shell thickness from approximately 300 measurements.
Monolayer-thickness continuation, Scheme 2/footnote, discussion including separately cited precedents and failed SILAR/c-ALD attempts; conclusions and supplied SI description.
CCDC accession, correspondence/ORCIDs/conflict declaration, funding/acknowledgments; references 1–29, including cited upstream procedures.
References 30–50 and note that October 6 artwork was replaced in corrected October 9, 2017 version.
Matching complete title, all six authors/affiliations and contents. DOI not printed on cover; pairing also supported by exact item correspondences to main.
Full Figure S1 FTIR trace, axes and six numerical peak labels/assignments; caption Zn(PTC)2 literature basis.
All 26 Table S1 rows and 104 numeric cells with uncertainties/scaling; THF-solvate O/C labels retained, negative and >1 fractional coordinates not wrapped.
All 26 Table S2 rows and 156 numeric cells, literal U11/U22/U33/U23/U13/U12 order, scaling and anisotropic exponent.
All 20 Table S3 H-atom rows and 80 numeric cells; uncertainties only where supplied; hydrogens from solvate retained.
All five Table S4 hydrogen-bond rows/20 numeric cells, atom/symmetry labels, and all four equivalent-atom transformations.
Full Figure S2 12 one-hour 1H NMR traces/markers and caption, including 11.2/5.0/9.8 ppm species and 1 h appearance description.
Full Figure S3 12 13C NMR traces, 209/193/180 ppm markers/caption and 1 h appearance description; traces are not digitized.
Both Figure S4 packing orientations and THF solvate molecules, source coordinate-system axes.
Figure S5 DMSO comparison photograph, layer versus dispersion, and explicitly inferential surface-exchange conclusion.
All 12 Table S5 elemental cells including four <0.5 results and sulfur dash; complete hypothetical-ligation sulfur mass-balance calculation.
Figure S6 DMSO/THF powder XRD traces, peak labels, lattice constants, bulk comparators and inconsistent printed percentage deviations.
Figure S7 EDS spectrum and full embedded numerical table, blank fields and totals; explicit THF powder caption, not a shell sample.
Figure S8 0–60 min NMR ratio graph and full caption defining p1/p2, added aniline versus no base, and conditional primary-amine discussion.
Figure S9 panels a/b, side and broad-facet HRTEM, each 10 nm scale; caption continues on S16.
Figure S9 panel c bundled belts, 200 nm scale and complete a/b/c caption.
Both SI references, bibliographic identity only; no external full-text review claimed.

supporting_information.scope: All supplied pages were read and visually inspected; distinct source audit passed corrected revision 2. Canonical/reader audits remain separate pending gates. Precursor coordinates do not supply product coordinates.

document_identity_verification.method: Exact source hashes; matching title and all six authors; main Associated Content and complete SI figure/table continuity. The SI cover does not print the DOI.

independent_audit: Complete supplied 10-page main article and matched 17-page SI read and independently audited. Separate canonical/reader, molecular and apparatus audits passed. Two shell-growth routes, eight supporting procedures and eight observation contexts remain distinct. Printed conflicts and unresolved specimen joins are preserved. Precursor crystal coordinates are not CdSe/CdS product coordinates. No new training task or exact structure–recipe pair is admitted.
publication_status: Published on the public MatterSyn GitHub Pages atlas; independent scientific, integration and actual browser checks passed. Exact release verification is recorded separately.

items.title: Heat the DMSO-d₆ sample and acquire the NMR time series
items.text: Dissolve the reported precursor charge in DMSO-d6 and heat at 50 °C. Acquire NMR spectra every 60 min over 12 h. Species appearance and disappearance are observations, not recipe inputs. Missing fields for this phase: tube atmosphere, heating hardware. C2: Main p3 prints 12 mg, 0.003 mmol for both NMR and THF controls.448.92 g/mol gives 0.02673 mmol. No silent tenfold correction. C6: Main p5 describes thiourea after 2 h; SI S2/S3 captions say 1 h. No single corrected onset inferred; chart/photo retained.

items.title: Hydrogen coordinates and isotropic displacement
items.text: All 20 hydrogen rows retain their printed coordinate and displacement values. Only the N–H positions have reported uncertainties; the riding-hydrogen distinction remains explicit. The measured atomic data describe Cd(PTC)₂·THF. They do not supply CdSe/CdS product coordinates or qualify a recipe–structure training pair.

items.text: The measured diffraction-crystal dimensions are distinct from the approximate mounting dimensions. The cell, space group, refinement statistics and formula apply to the THF-solvated precursor crystal. The measured atomic data describe Cd(PTC)₂·THF. They do not supply CdSe/CdS product coordinates or qualify a recipe–structure training pair.

remaining_gaps: Complete upstream NH4PTC and starting CdSe-QB syntheses are cited but not supplied; no new downloads or inferred recipe fields.

No original CIF/electronic reflection file supplied for CCDC 1560097; precursor PDF coordinates are transcribed but no reconstructed CIF/model validated. Product belts have no supplied atomic coordinates; precursor crystal is not the shell structure.
Starting dispersion0.512 g has no CdSe concentration or surface-area basis, so exact precursor/core ratio and 1.0–1.5monolayer-equivalent calculation cannot be reconstructed.

Several reaction volumes/durations, base dose, centrifuge settings outside belt workup, final dispersion concentration, drying/storage conditions and wash repeat count are unreported; no inheritance across control branches.
Solution precursor nuclearity/speciation unresolved; solid polymer+THF coordinates do not establish solution monomer or ligand geometry on belts.

Figures identify shell-growth families and specific same-panel optical specimens, but physical aliquot identity across TEM/XRD/elemental/optical assays is not fully specified. No exact per-experiment size/structure pairing inferred.
Original graphs retained and labeled values extracted; no spectrum/image digitization, kinetic fit, raw diffraction intensities or individual300thickness measurements reconstructed.
SILAR/c-ALD failures are qualitative author reports without reproducible failed-run recipes; not calibrated success-prediction labels.
No current-source Raman, SAED, device behavior or final-storage evidence supplied; cited Raman literature cannot be substituted.
Source, canonical/reader, molecular and apparatus audits passed. No precursor/product coordinate model is promoted. Integrated browser and publication gates remain separate.
